notica.config.title: Notica Config
notica.config.desc.playbackVariantOverri: Allows you to force a playback variant. By default, the playback variant is defined by the server.
notica.config.desc.stereoModeOverride: Allows you to force a stereo mixing mode for pre-processed songs. By default, the mixing mode is defined by the server.
notica.config.enum_desc.playbackVariantO: Recommended. Uses the default playback variant as defined by the server.
Always play notes individually and don't pre-process songs. May cut off sounds in songs with a lot of notes. Use this if you are experiencing problems with the default behaviour.
Always pre-process songs by combining all notes into a single sound. Notes are never cut off, even with a lot of notes.
notica.config.enum_desc.stereoModeOverri: Recommended. Uses the default stereo mixing mode as defined by the server.
Plays stereo sounds only on the channel where they are panned to. Tries to mimic vanilla result.
Smoothly shift stereo sounds between both channels. Sounds will always have the perceived volume.
notica.config.desc.dopplerIntensity: Multiplier for the doppler effect. 0 disables it, 1 is default, 2 doubles the effect.
notica.config.desc.listenerVelocity: Whether to apply the player's movement velocity to the OpenAL listener, enabling doppler effect from player motion. Warning: This will affect all game sounds and may be incompatible with other mods that implement the same.
